sections.title: 基础题 - Passage A (Yang BOT 机器人秧歌)
raw_text: On January 28, 2025, a special performance called Yang BOT amazed audiences at the CCTV Spring Festival Gala, China's most-watched TV show.
It was 1. ________ (direct) by famous filmmaker Zhang Yimou.
The show mixed traditional Chinese yangko dance with modern robot technology.
In the performance, humanoid robots (robots shaped like humans) dressed in 2. ________ (color) costumes danced yangko.
It is a joyful folk dance from northern China often seen during 3. ________ (festival).
They spun handkerchiefs instantly and formed creative group patterns.
These robots were developed by Unitree (宇树科技), 4. ________ Chinese robotics company.
This was not Unitree's 5. ________ (one) success in 2021, their robot cows named "Ben Ben" danced as backup for singer Andy Lau.
The robots learned dance moves through AI and used laser navigation to move safely on the stage.
Their strong joints (like knees with 360 N•m power) helped them balance 6. ________ (perfect) during fast steps.
Zhang Yimou explained, "This dance isn't just fun it shows 7. ________ technology can bring new life to traditions."
Thanks 8. ________ these innovations, the robots won the hearts of millions.
On social media, topics like "Robot Yangko" trended quickly.
Young viewers called it "cool," while older audiences loved 9. ________ (it) humor and festive spirit.
The Yang BOT program is a perfect mix of China's tech progress 10. ________ cultural pride.
As one fan said, "It's like watching the future and past dance together!"
filled_text: On January 28, 2025, a special performance called Yang BOT amazed audiences at the CCTV Spring Festival Gala, China's most-watched TV show.
It was directed by famous filmmaker Zhang Yimou.
The show mixed traditional Chinese yangko dance with modern robot technology.
In the performance, humanoid robots (robots shaped like humans) dressed in colorful costumes danced yangko.
It is a joyful folk dance from northern China often seen during festivals.
They spun handkerchiefs instantly and formed creative group patterns.
These robots were developed by Unitree (宇树科技), a Chinese robotics company.
This was not Unitree's first success in 2021, their robot cows named "Ben Ben" danced as backup for singer Andy Lau.
The robots learned dance moves through AI and used laser navigation to move safely on the stage.
Their strong joints (like knees with 360 N•m power) helped them balance perfectly during fast steps.
Zhang Yimou explained, "This dance isn't just fun it shows how/that technology can bring new life to traditions."
Thanks to these innovations, the robots won the hearts of millions.
On social media, topics like "Robot Yangko" trended quickly.
Young viewers called it "cool," while older audiences loved its humor and festive spirit.
The Yang BOT program is a perfect mix of China's tech progress and cultural pride.
As one fan said, "It's like watching the future and past dance together!"
filled_text_cn: 2025年1月28日，在中国收视率最高的电视节目央视春晚中，一个名为 Yang BOT 的特别节目震撼了观众。
它由著名导演张艺谋执导。
该节目将中国传统的秧歌舞与现代机器人科技融为一体。
在表演中，穿着色彩鲜艳服装的人形机器人（仿人形态的机器人）跳起了秧歌。
这是一种源自中国北方的欢快民间舞蹈，在节日期间经常能看到。
它们瞬间转动起手帕，并摆出富有创意的集体造型图案。
这些机器人由中国机器人公司宇树科技研发。
这并非宇树科技的第一次成功——在2021年，他们名为“犇犇”的机器牛曾为歌手刘德华伴舞。
机器人通过人工智能学习舞蹈动作，并利用激光导航在舞台上安全移动。
它们强劲的关节（如具备360 N•m动力的膝关节）帮助它们在快速步伐中完美地保持平衡。
张艺谋解释道：“这支舞蹈不仅有趣，它还展示了科技如何/能够为传统带来新的生命。”
多亏了这些创新，机器人们赢得了数百万观众的心。
在社交媒体上，“机器人秧歌”等话题迅速走红。
年轻观众称其“很酷”，而年长观众则喜欢它的幽默感和节日喜庆氛围。
Yang BOT 节目是中国科技进步与文化自豪感的完美结合。
正如一位粉丝所说：“这就像看着未来与过去共舞！”

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:它由著名导演张艺谋执导。根据'was'及后文'by'可知，主语 It 与 direct 是被动关系，构成一般过去时的被动语态 was directed。故填 directed。
questions.rule_summary: 主语为动作承受者时用 be + 过去分词表示被动语态。

questions.explanation: 句意:类人机器人穿着颜色鲜艳的服装跳起了秧歌。color是名词，此处需用其形容词形式 colorful“色彩鲜艳的”作定语修饰名词 costumes。故填 colorful。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词作定语时，名词 color 常派生为形容词 colorful。

questions.explanation: 句意:在节日里经常能看到这种舞蹈。festival 是可数名词，前面无限定词，用复数形式 festivals 表示泛指。故填 festivals。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词泛指某一类事物或在介词后表泛指概念时用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意:这些机器人是由一家中国机器人公司宇树科技研发的。此处泛指“一家中国机器人公司”，Chinese 以辅音音素开头，故用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指且以辅音音素开头时用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 句意:这并不是宇树科技的第一次成功。one 是基数词，空前有所有格 Unitree's 修饰单数名词 success，需用序数词 first“第一”。故填 first。
questions.rule_summary: 所有格或定冠词后修饰单数名词表示“第几”时用序数词。

questions.explanation: 句意:帮助它们在快速步伐中完美地保持平衡。perfect 是形容词，此处修饰动词 balance 需用副词 perfectly。故填 perfectly。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词作状语需用形容词变副词 (perfect -> perfectly)。

questions.explanation: 句意:它展示了科技如何/能够为传统带来新生命。shows 后面是宾语从句，从句意思完整可用 how 引导表示“如何”，也可用 that 引导陈述事实。故填 how/that。
questions.rule_summary: 动词后宾语从句中，表达方式时用 how，陈述客观事实可用 that。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:多亏了这些创新，机器人赢得了数百万人的心。thanks to 是固定短语，意为“多亏，由于”。故填 to。
questions.rule_summary: 固定搭配 thanks to 表示“多亏……，由于……”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 句意:年长观众喜欢它的幽默感和节日氛围。修饰名词短语 humor and festive spirit，需用形容词性物主代词 its“它的”。故填 its。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词作定语需用形容词性物主代词 (it -> its)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and / but / or / so)
questions.explanation: 句意:Yang BOT 节目是中国科技进步和文化自豪感的完美结合。China's tech progress 与 cultural pride 为并列关系，用 and 连接。故填 and。
questions.rule_summary: 连接两个并列名词短语时使用并列连词 and。

sections.title: 基础题 - Passage B (成语“露马脚”的故事)
raw_text: In China, people use the idiom loumajiao ("to reveal a horse's foot") to 1. ________ (description) a situation in which a secret is revealed.
There is a story behind it.
There was a time that women with small feet 2. ________ (believe) to be more beautiful.
Then young girls would be asked to painfully bind (捆绑) their feet to prevent them 3. ________ getting bigger.
Empress Ma, wife of Zhu Yuanzhang, the first emperor of the Ming Dynasty, refused to bind her feet but she liked to practice martial arts (武术).
So her feet 4. ________ (grow) larger than other women's feet.
After she became empress, Ma 5. ________ (hide) her feet by wearing long gowns (长袍).
One day, when she 6. ________ (sit) in a carriage near a busy street, a strong wind blew her gown up.
Taken by surprise, she was not able to hide her feet 7. ________ time.
Many people saw her feet and quickly spread the word across the country.
The idiom loumajiao comes from this story.
However, research shows that loumajiao may have come from a kind of ancient practice.
The qilin is a mythical (虚构的) animal that stands 8. ________ good luck.
In ancient times, people could paint a "qilin skin" on a large piece of cloth and put it on a horse so that the horse would look like a qilin.
However, the horse's feet were hard to cover up and could easily 9. ________ (see).
Gradually, loumajiao came to mean "revealing a secret".
In English, the idioms "spill (泼洒) the beans" or "let the cat out of the bag" have the same 10. ________ (mean).
filled_text: In China, people use the idiom loumajiao ("to reveal a horse's foot") to describe a situation in which a secret is revealed.
There is a story behind it.
There was a time that women with small feet were believed to be more beautiful.
Then young girls would be asked to painfully bind (捆绑) their feet to prevent them from getting bigger.
Empress Ma, wife of Zhu Yuanzhang, the first emperor of the Ming Dynasty, refused to bind her feet but she liked to practice martial arts (武术).
So her feet grew larger than other women's feet.
After she became empress, Ma hid her feet by wearing long gowns (长袍).
One day, when she was sitting in a carriage near a busy street, a strong wind blew her gown up.
Taken by surprise, she was not able to hide her feet in time.
Many people saw her feet and quickly spread the word across the country.
The idiom loumajiao comes from this story.
However, research shows that loumajiao may have come from a kind of ancient practice.
The qilin is a mythical (虚构的) animal that stands for good luck.
In ancient times, people could paint a "qilin skin" on a large piece of cloth and put it on a horse so that the horse would look like a qilin.
However, the horse's feet were hard to cover up and could easily be seen.
Gradually, loumajiao came to mean "revealing a secret".
In English, the idioms "spill (泼洒) the beans" or "let the cat out of the bag" have the same meaning.
filled_text_cn: 在中国，人们使用成语“露马脚”来描述秘密被揭露的情形。
这背后有一个故事。
曾经有一段时期，小脚的女性被认为更加美丽。
于是年轻姑娘们会被迫痛苦地缠足，以防止脚变大。
明朝开国皇帝朱元璋的妻子马皇后拒绝缠足，并且她喜欢练习武术。
因此她的脚长得比其他女性的脚都要大。
当上皇后之后，马皇后通过穿长袍把脚遮盖起来。
有一天，当她正坐在靠近热闹街道的马车里时，一阵大风把她的长袍掀了起来。
她措手不及，没能及时遮住双脚。
许多人看到了她的脚，并很快把消息传遍了全国。
成语“露马脚”便源于这个故事。
然而，研究表明“露马脚”也可能源自古代的一种习俗。
麒麟是一种代表好运的神话动物。
在古代，人们可以在一大块布上画出“麒麟皮”并披在马身上，让马看起来像麒麟。
但是，马蹄很难被遮盖住，很容易被看到。
渐渐地，“露马脚”便有了“泄露秘密”的意思。
在英语中，成语“spill the beans”或“let the cat out of the bag”有着相同的意思。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意:人们用成语“露马脚”来描述秘密被揭露的情况。use sth. to do sth.“用……做某事”，此处不定式符号 to 后需接动词原形 describe。故填 describe。
questions.rule_summary: use ... to do sth. 结构中接动词原形。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:曾经有一段时间，小脚的女人被认为更美丽。主语 women with small feet 为复数，且与 believe 之间是被动关系，叙述过去用一般过去时被动语态 were believed。故填 were believed。
questions.rule_summary: 复数主语 + 过去发生的事实 + 被动关系 = were done。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:以防止她们的脚变大。prevent sb./sth. from doing sth. 是固定词组，意为“阻止/防止……做某事”。故填 from。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 prevent ... from doing sth. 表示“阻止……发生”。

questions.explanation: 句意:所以她的脚长得比其他女人的脚更大。此处叙述明朝历史故事，句子为一般过去时，grow 的过去式为 grew。故填 grew。
questions.rule_summary: 叙述历史事件和过去动作使用一般过去时 (grow -> grew)。

questions.explanation: 句意:在她成为皇后之后，马皇后穿长袍遮住自己的脚。主句叙述过去的动作，用一般过去时，hide 的过去式为 hid。故填 hid。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时动词不规则变化 (hide -> hid)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态（过去进行时）
questions.explanation: 句意:有一天，当她正坐在靠近繁忙街道的马车里时，一阵强风掀起了她的长袍。when 引导的时间状语从句表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作，主语 she 为单数，用 was sitting。故填 was sitting。
questions.rule_summary: 过去某一突发事件发生时正在进行的背景动作用过去进行时 (was/were doing)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:她措手不及，没能及时藏起她的双脚。in time 为固定词组，意为“及时”。故填 in。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 in time 表示“及时”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:麒麟是一种代表好运的神话动物。stand for 为固定短语，意为“代表，象征”。故填 for。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 stand for 表示“代表，象征”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（含情态动词的被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:然而，马蹄很难被遮盖，很容易被看到。主语 horse's feet 与 see 是被动关系，且空前有情态动词 could 和副词 easily，故用 could easily be seen。故填 be seen。
questions.rule_summary: 情态动词后的被动语态结构为：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。

questions.explanation: 句意:成语“spill the beans”或“let the cat out of the bag”有着相同的意思。the same 后面需接名词作宾语，mean 的名词形式为 meaning“意思，含义”。故填 meaning。
questions.rule_summary: the same 后接名词形式 (mean -> meaning)。

sections.title: 提升题 - Passage A (宇航员邓清明的太空梦)
raw_text: Deng Qingming is a Chinese astronaut.
He finally entered Tiangong Space Station by Shenzhou-15 in November, 2022 after 25 1. ________ (year) hard work.
He is working with his teammates to carry out 2. ________ (task) in space.
Deng Qingming was born in Jiangxi Province in 1966.
He made use of every minute to study in place 3. ________ playing.
At the age of 31, Deng 4. ________ (choose) as one of the 14 first members of the PLA Astronaut Division.
Deng kept training hard for a chance to fly into space until he had kidney stones (肾结石) in 2013.
It was serious for astronauts because the 5. ________ (standard) for their health are high.
He had to stop training to have operations.
He 6. ________ (suffer) from the illness, but after two months, he continued working for his dream.
7. ________ happened to him, he never gave up.
In 2022, Deng's dream finally came true.
He was 56 years old and the last one of China's first astronauts to be sent into space.
He had never been 8. ________ (hope) for the past 25 years.
He had fought for his space dream the whole time.
He is such a true hero that his story 9. ________ (influence) many Chinese people.
And we all take 10. ________ (proud) in him.
filled_text: Deng Qingming is a Chinese astronaut.
He finally entered Tiangong Space Station by Shenzhou-15 in November, 2022 after 25 years' hard work.
He is working with his teammates to carry out tasks in space.
Deng Qingming was born in Jiangxi Province in 1966.
He made use of every minute to study in place of playing.
At the age of 31, Deng was chosen as one of the 14 first members of the PLA Astronaut Division.
Deng kept training hard for a chance to fly into space until he had kidney stones (肾结石) in 2013.
It was serious for astronauts because the standards for their health are high.
He had to stop training to have operations.
He suffered from the illness, but after two months, he continued working for his dream.
Whatever happened to him, he never gave up.
In 2022, Deng's dream finally came true.
He was 56 years old and the last one of China's first astronauts to be sent into space.
He had never been hopeless for the past 25 years.
He had fought for his space dream the whole time.
He is such a true hero that his story has influenced/influences many Chinese people.
And we all take pride in him.
filled_text_cn: 邓清明是一名中国航天员。
在付出了25年的艰苦努力后，他终于在2022年11月随神舟十五号进入了天宫空间站。
他正与队友们一起在太空中执行任务。
邓清明1966年出生于江西省。
他充分利用每一分钟来学习，而不是玩耍。
31岁时，邓清明被选拔为中国人民解放军航天员大队首批14名成员之一。
邓清明一直刻苦训练以争取飞向太空的机会，直到他在2013年患上了肾结石。
这对航天员来说是非常严重的，因为对他们身体健康的标准要求很高。
他不得不停止训练接受手术治疗。
他饱受疾病折磨，但两个月后，他继续为自己的梦想而拼搏。
无论发生什么，他都从未放弃。
2022年，邓清明的梦想终于成真。
他时年56岁，是中国首批航天员中最后一位被送入太空的人。
在过去的25年里，他从未感到绝望。
他一直在为自己的太空梦想而奋斗。
他是如此真正的一位英雄，以至于他的故事影响了许多中国人。
我们都为他感到自豪。

questions.explanation: 句意:经过25年的艰苦努力。25修饰名词需用复数 years，此处修饰名词短语 hard work 表示“……的”，需用复数所有格 years'。故填 years'。
questions.rule_summary: 以 s 结尾的复数名词所有格直接在词尾加 '。

questions.explanation: 句意:他正与队友们一起在太空执行任务。task 是可数名词，此处无单数限定词，需用复数形式 tasks 表示泛指。故填 tasks。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词泛指执行多项任务时用复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:他利用每一分钟来学习，而不是玩耍。in place of 为固定短语，意为“代替，而不是”。故填 of。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 in place of 意为“代替，而不是”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:31岁时，邓清明被选拔为航天员首批成员之一。主语 Deng 与 choose 是被动关系，且动作发生在过去，用一般过去时被动语态 was chosen。故填 was chosen。
questions.rule_summary: 单数主语 + 过去时间状语 + 被动关系 = was + 过去分词 (chosen)。

questions.explanation: 句意:因为对他们的健康标准要求很高。由后文谓语 are high 可知主语应为复数形式 standards。故填 standards。
questions.rule_summary: 根据主谓一致原则，复数谓语动词 are 要求主语为复数名词。

questions.explanation: 句意:他饱受疾病折磨，但两个月后又继续奋斗。此处描述过去发生的事情，与后文 continued 并列保持一般过去时，填 suffered。故填 suffered。
questions.rule_summary: 描述过去的经历使用动词过去式 (suffered)。

questions.explanation: 句意:无论发生什么，他都从未放弃。whatever 意为“无论什么”，引导让步状语从句，句首大写首字母。故填 Whatever。
questions.rule_summary: whatever 引导让步状语从句，意为“无论发生什么”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词/副词反义前缀与派生
questions.explanation: 句意:在过去的25年里，他从未绝望过。结合 never 及下文坚持奋斗可知，此处表示“绝望的”，需填形容词 hopeless 作表语。故填 hopeless。
questions.rule_summary: 根据否定词 never 及上下文语境，填写带有否定后缀的形容词 hopeless。

questions.explanation: 句意:他的故事影响了许多中国人。强调对现在的影响可用现在完成时 has influenced，或与前面 is 保持一致用一般现在时三单 influences。故填 has influenced/influences。
questions.rule_summary: 主语为第三人称单数 his story，可用现在完成时或一般现在时。

questions.explanation: 句意:我们都为他感到自豪。take pride in 是固定搭配，意为“为……感到自豪”，proud 的名词形式为 pride。故填 pride。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 take pride in 意为“以……为自豪”。

sections.title: 提升题 - Passage B (潍坊聂家庄泥塑手工艺)
raw_text: Niejiazhuang Village in Weifang is famous for colored clay sculpture handicraft (泥塑手工艺), which dates back to the Ming Dynasty.
The Weifang government has encouraged local people 1. ________ (learn) traditional handicraft and make more money to get rid of poverty (脱贫).
Nie Peng is 2. ________ young villager in Niejiazhuang.
He is crazy about clay sculpture handicraft.
He began learning it from his father 3. ________ he was a child.

He has led lots of young craftsmen (手艺人) in and near 4. ________ (he) village to make colored clay sculptures and the handicraft has become an important way for local people to get 5. ________ (rich) than before.
The tiger is a typical subject for colored clay sculptures.
Nie 6. ________ (start) to learn to make clay tigers in 2010, the Year of the Tiger.
Over these years, he has seen the development of the art form.
7. ________ first, the clay tigers were all of the same small size.
Now there are tigers of different 8. ________ (size) and the largest can be over two meters tall.
The tigers used to 9. ________ (paint) pink and green, but now have become more colorful.
Today Nie cares for the future of clay sculpture handicraft that pushes young craftsmen to create more works.
He 10. ________ (real) hopes that the sculpture handicraft will be passed down to the next generation.
filled_text: Niejiazhuang Village in Weifang is famous for colored clay sculpture handicraft (泥塑手工艺), which dates back to the Ming Dynasty.
The Weifang government has encouraged local people to learn traditional handicraft and make more money to get rid of poverty (脱贫).
Nie Peng is a young villager in Niejiazhuang.
He is crazy about clay sculpture handicraft.
He began learning it from his father when he was a child.
He has led lots of young craftsmen (手艺人) in and near his village to make colored clay sculptures and the handicraft has become an important way for local people to get richer than before.
The tiger is a typical subject for colored clay sculptures.
Nie started to learn to make clay tigers in 2010, the Year of the Tiger.
Over these years, he has seen the development of the art form.
At first, the clay tigers were all of the same small size.
Now there are tigers of different sizes and the largest can be over two meters tall.
The tigers used to be painted pink and green, but now have become more colorful.
Today Nie cares for the future of clay sculpture handicraft that pushes young craftsmen to create more works.
He really hopes that the sculpture handicraft will be passed down to the next generation.
filled_text_cn: 潍坊聂家庄以彩绘泥塑手工艺闻名，该手工艺可追溯至明代。
潍坊市政府鼓励当地群众学习传统手工艺，赚更多的钱以实现脱贫。
聂鹏是聂家庄的一名年轻村民。
他对泥塑手工艺非常痴迷。
他从小就跟随父亲开始学习这门手艺。
他带领本村及附近的许多年轻手艺人制作彩绘泥塑，该手工艺已成为当地人变得比以前更富裕的重要途径。
泥老虎是彩绘泥塑的典型题材。
聂鹏在2010年虎年开始学习制作泥老虎。
这些年来，他见证了这种艺术形式的发展。
起初，泥老虎全都是同样的小尺寸。
现在有了不同尺寸的老虎，最大的可以超过两米高。
泥老虎过去常被涂成粉色和绿色，但现在变得更加色彩丰富了。
如今聂鹏关心泥塑手工艺的未来，这促使年轻手艺人创作出更多的作品。
他真心地希望这项雕塑手工艺能够代代相传。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意:潍坊政府鼓励当地人学习传统手工艺。encourage sb. to do sth. 为固定结构，意为“鼓励某人做某事”。故填 to learn。
questions.rule_summary: encourage sb. to do sth. 固定搭配接动词不定式作宾补。

questions.explanation: 句意:聂鹏是聂家庄的一个年轻村民。修饰单数名词 young villager 表泛指，young 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指且修饰词以辅音音素开头时用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 句意:当他还是个孩子的时候，他就开始向父亲学习。引导时间状语从句表示“当……时候”，用连词 when。故填 when。
questions.rule_summary: when 引导时间状语从句，意为“当……的时候”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 句意:他带领他村里及附近的许多年轻手艺人。修饰名词 village 需用形容词性物主代词 his“他的”。故填 his。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词作定语时用形容词性物主代词 (he -> his)。

questions.explanation: 句意:成为当地人比以前更富有的一种重要途径。空后有比较标志词 than，get + 比较级表示“变得更……”，填 richer。故填 richer。
questions.rule_summary: 由 than 提示，形容词用比较级形式 (rich -> richer)。

questions.explanation: 句意:聂在2010年虎年开始学习制作泥老虎。根据明确过去时间状语 in 2010 可知，谓语动词用过去式 started。故填 started。
questions.rule_summary: 明确过去时间状语 (in 2010) 要求句子使用一般过去时。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:起初，泥老虎全都是同样的小尺寸。at first 为固定短语，意为“起初，最初”，句首首字母大写。故填 At。
questions.rule_summary: 固定介词短语 at first 意为“起初”。

questions.explanation: 句意:现在有不同尺寸的老虎。different 修饰可数名词需用复数形式 sizes。故填 sizes。
questions.rule_summary: different 后接可数名词复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:这些老虎过去常被涂成粉色和绿色。主语 The tigers 与 paint 之间是被动关系，used to 后接动词原形，构成 used to be painted。故填 be painted。
questions.rule_summary: used to be done 表示“过去常常被……”。

questions.explanation: 句意:他真心地希望雕塑手工艺能传承给下一代。修饰动词 hopes 需用副词 really。故填 really。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词作状语用形容词派生的副词 really。

sections.title: 提升题 - Passage C (Daniel与破碎玻璃的艺术)
raw_text: Daniel, a little boy, lived in a small town.
He loved a beautiful glass which 1. ________ (give) by his grandmother.
One day, Daniel knocked over the glass on the table while playing.
The glass 2. ________ (fall) to the ground and broke into a million pieces.
Tears were in his eyes.
His mom walked in when she heard 3. ________ sound, saw the broken glass and Daniel's teary eyes and whispered, "It's okay, Daniel. What I care most about is that you haven't been hurt."
Daniel said, "But Grandma gave it to me and I love the glass."
Mom said, "I know, dear, but there are some things 4. ________ we can't get back, even if we like them more."
Then Mom helped clean up the pieces while telling, "Everyone makes mistakes. The important thing is to learn from 5. ________ (they) and become better."
Daniel thought for a moment 6. ________ asked, "What should I do?"
Mom smiled and replied, "First learn to forgive yourself. Then find ways to avoid the same mistakes."
In the following 7. ________ (day), Daniel began learning to make small crafts.
He wanted to make a nice painting with those glass pieces.
The day he finished his work, he was excited to show it 8. ________ his family.
The painting shone beautifully with broken glass.
"You 9. ________ (turn) loss into creation already," Mom was touched and said, "That is 10. ________ (valuable) than any glass."
Daniel understood the brokenness in life was not only loss, but also a chance for a new beginning and creation.
filled_text: Daniel, a little boy, lived in a small town.
He loved a beautiful glass which was given by his grandmother.
One day, Daniel knocked over the glass on the table while playing.
The glass fell to the ground and broke into a million pieces.
Tears were in his eyes.
His mom walked in when she heard the sound, saw the broken glass and Daniel's teary eyes and whispered, "It's okay, Daniel. What I care most about is that you haven't been hurt."
Daniel said, "But Grandma gave it to me and I love the glass."
Mom said, "I know, dear, but there are some things that/which we can't get back, even if we like them more."
Then Mom helped clean up the pieces while telling, "Everyone makes mistakes. The important thing is to learn from them and become better."
Daniel thought for a moment and asked, "What should I do?"
Mom smiled and replied, "First learn to forgive yourself. Then find ways to avoid the same mistakes."
In the following days, Daniel began learning to make small crafts.
He wanted to make a nice painting with those glass pieces.
The day he finished his work, he was excited to show it to his family.
The painting shone beautifully with broken glass.
"You have turned loss into creation already," Mom was touched and said, "That is more valuable than any glass."
Daniel understood the brokenness in life was not only loss, but also a chance for a new beginning and creation.
filled_text_cn: 小男孩丹尼尔住在一个小镇上。
他很喜欢一个漂亮的玻璃杯，那是他祖母送给他的。
有一天，丹尼尔在玩耍时不小心打翻了桌上的玻璃杯。
玻璃杯掉在地上，摔成了无数碎片。
他的眼里噙满了泪水。
妈妈听到声音走了进来，看到碎玻璃和丹尼尔含泪的双眼，轻声说：“没关系，丹尼尔。我最关心的是你没有受伤。”
丹尼尔说：“可是那是奶奶给我的，我很喜欢这个杯子。”
妈妈说：“我知道，亲爱的，但有些东西我们无法挽回，即使我们再喜欢它们。”
接着妈妈一边帮忙收拾碎片一边说：“每个人都会犯错。重要的是从错误中吸取教训，让自己变得更好。”
丹尼尔想了一会儿，问道：“那我该怎么做呢？”
妈妈微笑着回答：“首先学会原谅自己。然后找到避免犯同样错误的方法。”
在接下来的几天里，丹尼尔开始学习制作小手工艺品。
他想用那些玻璃碎片做一幅漂亮的画。
作品完成那天，他兴奋地向家人展示。
那幅画因碎玻璃而闪闪发光，格外美丽。
“你已经把失去变成了创造，”妈妈感动地说，“这比任何玻璃杯都更有价值。”
丹尼尔明白了，生活中的破碎不仅是失去，更是重新开始和创造的契机。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:他很喜欢一个漂亮的玻璃杯，那是祖母给他的。which 指代 glass，与 give 是被动关系，且发生在过去，用一般过去时被动语态 was given。故填 was given。
questions.rule_summary: 定语从句中先行词为单数物且在从句中作受动者时用 was given。

questions.explanation: 句意:玻璃杯掉在地上摔成了无数碎片。与后文 broke 并列，叙述过去发生的事，fall 用过去式 fell。故填 fell。
questions.rule_summary: 叙述过去的并列动作使用动词过去式 (fall -> fell)。

questions.explanation: 句意:当她听到那个声音时走了进来。此处特指玻璃杯摔碎的声音，用定冠词 the。故填 the。
questions.rule_summary: 特指语境中特定的声音或事物用定冠词 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 定语从句关系代词 (that / which)
questions.explanation: 句意:但有些东西我们无法找回。先行词为 some things，在定语从句中作 get back 的宾语，可用 that 或 which 引导。故填 that/which。
questions.rule_summary: 先行词指物且在定语从句中作宾语时，关系代词用 that 或 which。

questions.explanation: 句意:重要的是从它们中吸取教训并变得更好。介词 from 后面需用代词宾格 them 指代前面的 mistakes。故填 them。
questions.rule_summary: 介词后作宾语需用人称代词宾格形式 (they -> them)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and / but / or / so)
questions.explanation: 句意:Daniel 想了一会儿，然后问道。thought for a moment 与 asked 为先后承接的并列动作，用 and 连接。故填 and。
questions.rule_summary: 顺承连接两个并列谓语动作时使用 and。

questions.explanation: 句意:在接下来的几天里，Daniel 开始学习制作小工艺品。the following days 表示“在接下来的几天里”，需用复数形式 days。故填 days。
questions.rule_summary: in the following days 短语中 day 使用复数形式 days。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:他兴奋地把它展示给家人看。show sth. to sb. 为固定搭配，意为“把某物展示给某人看”。故填 to。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 show sth. to sb. 表示“向某人展示某物”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态（现在完成时）
questions.explanation: 句意:“你已经把失去变成了创造，”妈妈感动地说。由句中标志词 already 及强调动作已完成对现在产生影响可知用现在完成时，主语 You 对应助动词 have turned。故填 have turned。
questions.rule_summary: already 提示现在完成时结构 have/has + 过去分词。

questions.explanation: 句意:“那比任何玻璃杯都更有价值。”空后有比较标志词 than，多音节形容词 valuable 的比较级为 more valuable。故填 more valuable。
questions.rule_summary: than 提示多音节形容词前面加 more 构成比较级。

sections.title: 拔高题 - Passage A (蟳埔簪花文化)
raw_text: As an old saying in Xunpu, Fujian province goes, "Put flowers in your hair in this life and you'll also be pretty in the afterlife".
In the past, all the women in the small fishing village were glad to have long hair, and they put colorful and special headdresses on their hair.
The headdress is known 1. ________ zanhua.
Here's a story of a master, Huang Rongbing.
As a child, Huang Rongbing often watched his mother put colorful headdresses into her hair.
The headdress gave Huang an idea for his career choice.
In 2016, he and his elder sister opened a salon (美发店).
There tourists could get their hair styled in the Xunpu tradition and had their photos 2. ________ (take).
"We have been booked 3. ________ (full) and now there are over 200 businesses 4. ________ (offer) a high level of services to tourists," said Huang.
The increase in tourist visits has made Huang happy.
That's 5. ________ it not only keeps the business busy but also makes more people 6. ________ (interest) in zanhua.
It helps spread the history and culture behind zanhua headwear quickly at home and abroad.
After going through the full zanhua experience, Hu Titi, one of Huang's 7. ________ (customer), even brought zanhua culture to Paris in France last year.
Under the Eiffel Tower, she made videos of 8. ________ (she) in traditional Chinese clothes with a zanhua in her hair.
Huang said the women of Xunpu are the 9. ________ (brave) and most hard-working in his mind.
They are famous for catching the best seafood.
"When they put a zanhua on their heads, they express their wish for happiness.
The flowers 10. ________ (see) as a symbol of hope," he added.
filled_text: As an old saying in Xunpu, Fujian province goes, "Put flowers in your hair in this life and you'll also be pretty in the afterlife".
In the past, all the women in the small fishing village were glad to have long hair, and they put colorful and special headdresses on their hair.
The headdress is known as zanhua.
Here's a story of a master, Huang Rongbing.
As a child, Huang Rongbing often watched his mother put colorful headdresses into her hair.
The headdress gave Huang an idea for his career choice.
In 2016, he and his elder sister opened a salon (美发店).
There tourists could get their hair styled in the Xunpu tradition and had their photos taken.
"We have been booked fully and now there are over 200 businesses offering a high level of services to tourists," said Huang.
The increase in tourist visits has made Huang happy.
That's because it not only keeps the business busy but also makes more people interested in zanhua.
It helps spread the history and culture behind zanhua headwear quickly at home and abroad.
After going through the full zanhua experience, Hu Titi, one of Huang's customers, even brought zanhua culture to Paris in France last year.
Under the Eiffel Tower, she made videos of herself in traditional Chinese clothes with a zanhua in her hair.
Huang said the women of Xunpu are the bravest and most hard-working in his mind.
They are famous for catching the best seafood.
"When they put a zanhua on their heads, they express their wish for happiness.
The flowers are seen as a symbol of hope," he added.
filled_text_cn: 正如福建蟳埔的一句古话所说：“今生簪花，来世漂亮”。
在过去，这个小渔村里的所有妇女都喜欢留长发，并在头发上佩戴色彩斑斓且独具特色的头饰。
这种头饰被称为“簪花”。
这里讲述的是一位手艺大师黄荣兵的故事。
孩提时代，黄荣兵经常看着母亲把鲜艳的头饰插进头发里。
这种头饰给黄荣兵的职业选择带来了灵感。
2016年，他和姐姐开了一家美发沙龙。
在那里，游客们可以按照蟳埔传统打理发型并拍下照片。
黄荣兵说：“我们的预约已经全满，现在有200多家商户为游客提供高水平的服务。”
游客人数的增加让黄荣兵感到很高兴。
这是因为这不仅让生意红火，而且让更多的人对簪花产生兴趣。
它有助于将簪花头饰背后的历史与文化迅速传播到海内外。
在体验了完整的簪花流程后，黄荣兵的一位顾客胡婷婷去年甚至将簪花文化带到了法国巴黎。
在埃菲尔铁塔下，她拍摄了自己身着中国传统服饰、头戴簪花的视频。
黄荣兵说，在他心目中蟳埔的妇女是最勇敢、最勤劳的。
她们以捕捞最优质的海鲜而闻名。
他补充道：“当她们把簪花戴在头上时，表达了对幸福的期盼。这些花被视为希望的象征。”

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:这种头饰被称为簪花。be known as 为固定搭配，意为“作为……而闻名/被称为”。故填 as。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 be known as 表示“作为……而出名/被称为……”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：过去分词作宾补
questions.explanation: 句意:还可以拍照片。have sth. done 为固定句型，意为“让某事被完成”，photos 与 take 为被动关系，用过去分词 taken 作宾补。故填 taken。
questions.rule_summary: have sth. done 结构中用过去分词作宾语补足语。

questions.explanation: 句意:“我们已经被订满了”。修饰动词 booked 需用形容词 full 派生的副词 fully。故填 fully。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词作状语用副词 fully。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：现在分词作定语
questions.explanation: 句意:现在有200多家商户为游客提供高水平的服务。There be sb./sth. doing sth. 结构中用现在分词作后置定语，businesses 与 offer 为主动关系。故填 offering。
questions.rule_summary: There be 结构中用现在分词 (offering) 作后置定语表示主动进行。

questions.grammar_point_name: 从属连词与状语从句（表语从句）
questions.explanation: 句意:这是因为它不仅让生意繁忙，而且让更多人对簪花感兴趣。That's because... 为固定句型，用于解释前面的原因。故填 because。
questions.rule_summary: That's because... 引导表语从句解释原因。

questions.explanation: 句意:使更多的人对簪花产生兴趣。be/become/make sb. interested in 为固定搭配，修饰人对某事物感兴趣用 interested。故填 interested。
questions.rule_summary: 形容人感到有兴趣用 -ed 结尾的形容词 interested。

questions.explanation: 句意:黄的一位顾客胡婷婷。one of + 可数名词复数表示“……之一”，故填 customers。
questions.rule_summary: one of 结构后接可数名词复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意:她拍摄了自己穿着传统中国服装的视频。主语 she 与宾语指同一个人，用反身代词 herself。故填 herself。
questions.rule_summary: 主语和宾语指同一人时使用反身代词 herself。

questions.explanation: 句意:在他看来，蟳埔的妇女是最勇敢、最勤劳的。与后文 most hard-working 并列，空前有 the，需用最高级形式 bravest。故填 bravest。
questions.rule_summary: the + 最高级与 and most hard-working 构成并列最高级。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:这些花被视为希望的象征。主语 The flowers 为复数，描述客观象征意义用一般现在时的被动语态 are seen。故填 are seen。
questions.rule_summary: 复数主语 + 一般现在时 + 被动关系 = are + 过去分词 (seen)。

sections.title: 拔高题 - Passage B (博茨瓦纳农场助手App)
raw_text: Wu Zeyin, 12, comes from Hubei, China.
He 1. ________ (move) to Botswana with his family eight years ago.
"I can see only a few kinds of fruit and vegetables at supermarkets here.
They don't look good, but their prices are high," Wu said.
Because of the desert climate (气候) in Botswana, it is 2. ________ (true) difficult for farmers there to grow fruit and vegetables.
Botswana has to buy lots of fruit and vegetables from other 3. ________ (country), such as South Africa.
Botswana has been working with China 4. ________ (solve) this problem.
In July 2022, Botswana started 5. ________ program to grow China's water-saving rice.
Knowing it, Wu wanted to help with local agriculture (当地的农业) in his way.
"I dreamed 6. ________ creating an app to help local farmers," Wu said.
Wu has a good brain and he has made his dream come true by 7. ________ (develop) a new app called Farm Assistant.
The app can teach farmers how to grow vegetables such as potatoes, onions, carrots and cabbages.
Farmers who use the app can click (点击) on a picture of a vegetable to see 8. ________ (it) seed (种子) price, watering needs, selling price, etc.
After the farmers plant the seeds, the app can remind them 9. ________ they need to do at different times.
Wu hopes his app can make the farmers' work a lot 10. ________ (easy) than before.
What a useful app and what a smart boy!
filled_text: Wu Zeyin, 12, comes from Hubei, China.
He moved to Botswana with his family eight years ago.
"I can see only a few kinds of fruit and vegetables at supermarkets here.
They don't look good, but their prices are high," Wu said.
Because of the desert climate (气候) in Botswana, it is truly difficult for farmers there to grow fruit and vegetables.
Botswana has to buy lots of fruit and vegetables from other countries, such as South Africa.
Botswana has been working with China to solve this problem.
In July 2022, Botswana started a program to grow China's water-saving rice.
Knowing it, Wu wanted to help with local agriculture (当地的农业) in his way.
"I dreamed of creating an app to help local farmers," Wu said.
Wu has a good brain and he has made his dream come true by developing a new app called Farm Assistant.
The app can teach farmers how to grow vegetables such as potatoes, onions, carrots and cabbages.
Farmers who use the app can click (点击) on a picture of a vegetable to see its seed (种子) price, watering needs, selling price, etc.
After the farmers plant the seeds, the app can remind them what they need to do at different times.
Wu hopes his app can make the farmers' work a lot easier than before.
What a useful app and what a smart boy!
filled_text_cn: 今年12岁的吴泽胤来自中国湖北。
八年前，他和家人一起搬到了博茨瓦纳。
吴说：“在当地超市里我只能看到少数几种水果和蔬菜。
它们卖相不好，但价格却很高。”
由于博茨瓦纳的沙漠气候，当地农民种植水果和蔬菜确实非常困难。
博茨瓦纳不得不从南非等其他国家购买大量的水果和蔬菜。
博茨瓦纳一直在与中国合作来解决这一难题。
2022年7月，博茨瓦纳启动了一项种植中国节水水稻的计划。
得知此事后，吴泽胤想用自己的方式帮助当地农业。
吴说：“我梦想着制作一款应用程序来帮助当地农民。”
吴泽胤很有头脑，他通过开发一款名为“农场助手”的新应用实现了自己的梦想。
该应用可以指导农民如何种植土豆、洋葱、胡萝卜和卷心菜等蔬菜。
使用该应用的农民可以点击蔬菜图片查看其种子价格、浇水需求、销售价格等信息。
农民播种后，该应用可以在不同时间提醒他们需要做什么。
吴泽胤希望他的应用能让农民的工作比以前轻松得多。
多么实用的应用，多么聪明的男孩啊！

questions.explanation: 句意:八年前，他和家人搬到了博茨瓦纳。根据明确过去时间状语 eight years ago，谓语动词用过去式 moved。故填 moved。
questions.rule_summary: ... ago 提示句子使用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 句意:那里的农民种植果蔬确实很困难。修饰形容词 difficult 需用副词 truly。故填 truly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰形容词作状语 (true -> truly)。

questions.explanation: 句意:不得不从其他国家购买大量果蔬。other 后接可数名词复数形式 countries。故填 countries。
questions.rule_summary: other 后接可数名词复数形式 (country -> countries)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意:博茨瓦纳一直在与中国合作以解决这个问题。此处用动词不定式 to solve 作目的状语。故填 to solve。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式作目的状语，表示“为了解决……”。

questions.explanation: 句意:2022年7月，博茨瓦纳启动了一项种植中国节水水稻的计划。修饰单数名词 program 表泛指，program 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指一个单数可数名词且以辅音音素开头时用不定冠词 a。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:“我梦想着创建一个应用来帮助当地农民”。dream of doing sth. 为固定搭配，意为“梦想做某事”。故填 of。
questions.rule_summary: 固定搭配 dream of doing sth. 表示“梦想做某事”。

questions.explanation: 句意:他通过开发一款新应用实现了梦想。介词 by 后接动名词 developing 作宾语。故填 developing。
questions.rule_summary: 介词 by 后接动名词 -ing 形式作宾语表示方式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 句意:查看它的种子价格、浇水需求等。修饰名词短语 seed price 需用形容词性物主代词 its“它的”。故填 its。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词作定语用形容词性物主代词 its。

questions.explanation: 句意:该应用可以在不同时间提醒他们需要做什么。remind sb. 后跟宾语从句，从句中 do 缺少宾语，用 what 引导。故填 what。
questions.rule_summary: 宾语从句中缺少动词 do 的宾语时用连接代词 what 引导。

questions.explanation: 句意:希望他的应用能让农民的工作比以前轻松得多。a lot 修饰比较级，且后有 than before，easy 的比较级为 easier。故填 easier。
questions.rule_summary: a lot 及 than before 提示使用形容词比较级 easier。

sections.title: 拔高题 - Passage C (《逃出大英博物馆》)
raw_text: On 1. ________ Aug. 30, a three-episode web series (三集网剧) called Escape From the British Museum 2. ________ (become) popular online with its touching and creative story.
The series follows the journey home of 3. ________ Chinese jade teapot (玉茶壶) that has come to life.
She runs away from the British Museum and comes across a Chinese reporter named Zhang Yong'an who helps the artifact (文物) 4. ________ (return) to China.
The series, created by Xiatian Meimei, hopes to draw people's attention to Chinese artifacts that are kept abroad.
5. ________ (get) ready for the TV show, they started making their own 6. ________ (video) for three months and went to the UK to learn about the story of the Chinese jade teapot.
Many people have been touched by the lines in the series, such as "My family, I have been 7. ________ (lost) for a long time," and "As long as I'm with my family, I'm safe."
Also, the face of the "jade teapot" is dirty, and she is surprised by 8. ________ big the reporter's house is compared to her own place a crowded cabinet (陈列柜).
Viewers say this shows that the British Museum doesn't take care of the artifacts 9. ________ (good).
In mid-August, it 10. ________ (report) that more than 2,000 artifacts were "missing or damaged (损坏的)", so many people call for the return of Chinese artifacts.
filled_text: On Aug. 30, a three-episode web series (三集网剧) called Escape From the British Museum has become popular online with its touching and creative story.
The series follows the journey home of a Chinese jade teapot (玉茶壶) that has come to life.
She runs away from the British Museum and comes across a Chinese reporter named Zhang Yong'an who helps the artifact (文物) return/to return to China.
The series, created by Xiatian Meimei, hopes to draw people's attention to Chinese artifacts that are kept abroad.
To get ready for the TV show, they started making their own videos for three months and went to the UK to learn about the story of the Chinese jade teapot.
Many people have been touched by the lines in the series, such as "My family, I have been lost for a long time," and "As long as I'm with my family, I'm safe."
Also, the face of the "jade teapot" is dirty, and she is surprised by how big the reporter's house is compared to her own place a crowded cabinet (陈列柜).
Viewers say this shows that the British Museum doesn't take care of the artifacts well.
In mid-August, it was reported that more than 2,000 artifacts were "missing or damaged (损坏的)", so many people call for the return of Chinese artifacts.
filled_text_cn: 8月30日，一部名为《逃出大英博物馆》的三集短剧凭借感人且富有创意的故事在网络上走红。
该剧讲述了一只化为人形的中华缠枝纹薄胎玉壶的归家之旅。
她从大英博物馆逃出，偶遇了一名名叫张永安的中国记者，后者帮助这件文物返回中国。
这部由“煎饼果仔”与“夏天妹妹”创作的短剧，旨在唤起人们对流失海外的中国文物的关注。
为了准备这部短剧，他们自费制作视频长达三个月，并专程前往英国了解玉壶背后的故事。
剧中的经典台词打动了无数人，例如“家人，我在外面流落好久了”以及“只要和家人在一起，我就安全了”。
此外，“小玉壶”的脸是脏兮兮的，而且比起自己身处的拥挤陈列柜，她惊讶于记者的房子有多大。
观众们表示，这表明大英博物馆并没有很好地照顾这些文物。
8月中旬，据报道有两千多件藏品“失踪或受损”，因此许多人呼吁归还中国文物。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:在8月30日，三集网剧《逃出大英博物馆》在网上走红。具体的日期前用介词 on。故填 on。
questions.rule_summary: 具体日期（如 Aug. 30）前使用介词 on。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态（现在完成时）
questions.explanation: 句意:网剧走红并对现在造成巨大影响，用现在完成时，主语 a three-episode web series 为单数，助动词用 has。故填 has become。
questions.rule_summary: 强调过去发生的事件对现在造成的影响时用现在完成时 (has become)。

questions.explanation: 句意:讲述了一个化为人形的中国玉茶壶的回家之旅。泛指一个中国玉茶壶，Chinese 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指且以辅音音素开头时用不定冠词 a。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (help sb. do / to do)
questions.explanation: 句意:帮助这件文物回到中国。help sb. (to) do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“帮助某人做某事”，接省略 to 或带 to 的动词不定式。故填 return/to return。
questions.rule_summary: help sb. (to) do sth. 中不定式符号 to 可带可不带。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式作目的状语
questions.explanation: 句意:为了准备这个节目，他们开始制作自己的视频。此处用动词不定式作目的状语，句首首字母大写。故填 To get。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式置于句首作目的状语，意为“为了……”。

questions.explanation: 句意:他们开始制作自己的视频。video 是可数名词，此处表泛指需用复数形式 videos。故填 videos。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词泛指制作多段视频时用复数形式 videos。

questions.explanation: 句意:“家人，我已经迷路流落很久了”。be lost 为固定短语，意为“迷路，迷失”，lost 为形容词作表语。故填 lost。
questions.rule_summary: have been lost 中 lost 作为形容词表状态（迷路的，迷失的）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 感叹句/宾语从句连接词 (how)
questions.explanation: 句意:她很惊讶记者的房子比起她拥挤的展柜有多大。修饰形容词 big 表示程度用 how，“how + adj. + 主语 + 谓语”结构。故填 how。
questions.rule_summary: how 修饰形容词 big 引导宾语从句/感叹从句表示“多么，多大”。

questions.explanation: 句意:大英博物馆没有很好地照顾这些文物。修饰动词短语 take care of 需用副词 well。故填 well。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词短语需用形容词 good 对应的副词 well。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:8月中旬，据报道有两千多件文物失踪或损坏。it was reported that... 为固定句型，叙述过去发生的事用一般过去时被动语态 was reported。故填 was reported。
questions.rule_summary: 固定句型 it was reported that... 意为“据报道……”。
